name: Microgrid renewable-surplus absorption request
summary: Requests compatible storage or controllable-load absorption for the assigned renewable surplus.
description: Requests compatible storage or controllable-load absorption for the assigned renewable surplus. Renewable-generation coordination connects variable resource availability, inverter operating limits and the microgrid power target. Available solar or wind power, an issued curtailment request and actual delivered power are different signals.

In a microgrid with solar generation, the controller can restrain inverter output when local load and storage cannot absorb the available power. The resource controller reports its own availability and accepted operating limits. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Renewable surplus and absorption limits” at the input and “Absorption request” at the output. Available charging capacity can be energy-constrained.
